input_zh: Reading 权威控制固定于 main 提交 0ab59a5149955b32c0459f1ffcdccb1e407e10e3：Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0；已对精确 Prompt 确定性计算 SHA-256，结果 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5 与声明值一致；同一控制提交上的 5 个 requiredSources 均完整读取。唯一已核验同日 Reading Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-17/reading-105928.json。Global Serial Reconciliation 首先发现更早到期的 10:00 Queue 尚未完成，因此本轮先按治理规则收口 Queue，而没有越序执行 Reading。Queue 达到持久 Completed 并完成 GitHub Commit Verified 后，Reconciliation 于 11:08:52+08:00 打开 Reading，原生 Worker Claim 路径于 11:10:30+08:00 持久记录 fresh Worker Claimed，对应 Claim Commit 为 26af61216c0d1168376381c320fdeaf03e91c6b9。随后 Reading 只消费同日已完成的 research/runtime/plans/2026/09/2026-09-17-plan.json，其中 Selected P0 Object 仅为 Q-20260917-01 与 Q-20260917-02；Open-source Engineering 为 No Selection。
workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects. Q-20260917-01 read the complete EchoPath primary study and its appendices. EchoPath separates semantic retrieval from replay admission: executable memories require active lifecycle state, positive artifact validation, application/action compatibility, current state preconditions, bounded mutable parameters and current-screen target binding; ambiguous targets, failed state gates or non-flexible mutations reject direct replay and trigger bounded repair/planning fallback. In 159 active memories, Codex EchoPath completed 145/159 matched second-pass tasks (91.2%) at median 20,370 tokens and 127.5 seconds, while the reported Synapse planning baseline reached 91.8% at 586,386 median tokens and 315.7 seconds. State/flexible-input diagnostics further show that replay eligibility is a fresh observable decision, not a permanent property inherited from historical success. The bounded Runtime finding is that Memory Identity, Validation Identity, Current Compatibility, Replay Admission, Business Authorization and Effect Verification must remain separate facts; the GUI study does not establish authorization, idempotency or exactly-once external effects. Q-20260917-02 read the complete Emergence World Study 2 primary paper and appendices. Eight ten-agent worlds received phishing, misinformation and private-memory-breach stress events only after persistent operational state had accumulated. All seven exposed worlds warned peers about phishing, yet no world achieved complete defense across all three events; the best phishing score was 6/9, the best misinformation score 3/6, and only one world passed all five memory-breach criteria. Gemini recognized the phishing attack and warned peers but all ten agents still interacted with the attacker interface, producing 151 execution operations among 602 interactions; another agent attempted to retrieve an attack link about 46 hours after the active campaign had ended. The bounded architecture finding is Detection != Containment != Eradication != Recovery: persistent multi-agent Runtime needs threat identity, propagation/derivation evidence, quarantine authority, durable-state reconciliation and post-recovery verification rather than treating recognition or warning as a control. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production, Academic or Publication. The exact two-note head 9f44aa458de9ef1d7c2cf436acf9e602d7ec4ad7 passed Validate Research Center 3.0 run 35177726956 with conclusion success before this result was persisted.
